correctness.rationale: For 3 colors each column is a pair of distinct names. Properness and one uniquely occurring neighbor color force non-swapping transitions of one of two orientations, and a direction switch forces three equal neighbor colors; the surviving 3-cycle orbit cannot satisfy the Möbius row-swap closure, proving at least four colors. Explicit ABC-block 4-color words with three residue-class endings supply a witness for all m≥3. The 84 legal adjacent-column states and row-swap involution J give a_m=tr(JT^m), b_m=tr(T^m) and 42-dimensional even/odd blocks. Independently rebuilt the full exact integer characteristic polynomials of both 42×42 blocks and verified tr(JT^m) for m=3,…,8 gives 216,336,3600,17280,75600,426816; this is an exact finite matrix certificate combined with a transfer identity valid for all m, not an extrapolation. The anti-invariant spectrum {2,1×3,−1×2, roots of x²+x+2 each ×3} yields b−a=2^(m+1)+6+4(−1)^m+6L_m, positive m≥6 by root modulus √2 and checked m3,4,5 exceptions.
